title: Blasting Their Way
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Blasting Their Way aboard the Millennium Falcon, Leia, Lando and Chewbacca exchange fire with stormtroopers at a Cloud City landing bay in this Marvel pin-up by Marshall Rogers (front). In the adaptation of THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK by Williamson and Garzon, plucky R2-D2 fixes the deactivated hyperdrive, allowing Luke to escape the clutches of Darth Vader (back).
